findings.claim: All four retained-pointer scan starts/descending strides are recovered; normal side8/16/32 caller phases keep their half-open footprints within one page.
findings.limitations: Normal safety requires recovered dyadic root phase, valid backing and bounded coordinates. Native slice has supplied Linux/image/grid environment and bypasses earlier LOD/height tests; unaligned cases are injected. Full source geometry is Ghidra original-instruction execution with inherited services and original root/hull inputs. Unsafe words are not read. No native full-geometry, retail Windows, arbitrary-corruption or whole-renderer claim.
